title: organiseCopies
body:
## organiseCopies

Make a named, foldered set of exact byte copies of photos (and optionally their adjacent sidecars) inside the run, from an inline name rule or a planNames document, with a stale-plan check, create-only copying, fixed artifact slots and a tree proof that every copy equals its capture.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Copies stay inside the run directory; there is no delivery elsewhere and no archive.
- A plan made for other bytes is refused as stale; an unrelated sidecar is never matched by name alone.
- Organising is not privacy or provenance certification: the copies carry all the original metadata.

Native binding: `no native write: exact byte copies of the captures are created by the host under organised/; the fixed listing anchors the reads the names came from`. Output kind: `["text","image"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `names` | How files are named and foldered: the closed rule inline, or the path of a planNames document (a workflow can bind that artifact). A plan made for other bytes is refused as stale before anything is copied. | | `sidecars` | carry (default) copies each photo's adjacent sidecar beside its image under the same stem; omit copies images only. The stem of an image and its sidecar are always one collision unit. | `{"type":"enum","values":["carry","omit"]}` | omitted |
